data.name: Locked in love : The Office
data.detailed_description:
Game Introduction

Just ahead of the "Golden Holiday," you receive sudden overtime work from your company.

Overcome with exhaustion after working late into the night, you fall asleep.

When you open your eyes the next day, you find yourself locked inside the office building.

You must escape this place before the holiday ends to enjoy your much-deserved Golden Holiday.

But wait... everyone trapped with you is a beautiful woman?! Depending on your choices, your relationships with them—and your ultimate escape—will unfold in entirely different ways.

Star-Studded Cast

Featuring Kep1er's CHOI YUJIN, Secret Number's EBIN, ARTBEAT's Oh Yu Bin, actresses Kim So Eun and Heo Yun Ha,

comedy duo GGILGGILMARKET’s Jang Yoon Seok and Lim Jong Hyuk, alongside other hidden famous actors!

Puzzles and Mysteries

No one will tell you why you are trapped or how to get out.

You must calmly observe your surroundings, gather clues, and forge your own path forward.

Multiple Endings and Various Heroines

As you attempt to escape the office, you will cross paths with several heroines.

Your choices will lead to a wide variety of conclusions.

Will you be able to escape the company and enjoy your holiday? If you do, who will be standing by your side?

Heroine Introductions

CHAEEUN

Your junior at work. She is undeniably a brilliant talent who managed to get hired at a very young age,

but strangely, she tends to make a lot of mistakes only when she's in front of you.

SOMIN

Your senior at work. She is famous for being prickly and sharp with everyone, but for some reason, she is exceptionally kind to you.

LARA

A famous celebrity your company is trying to cast as an advertising model.

Successfully casting her without getting on her bad side is one of your top priorities.

GIA

Your childhood friend. She works as a barista at the cafe downstairs from your office.

She always prepares your usual order right on time for your arrival.

DYNE

The company cleaner. She always approaches you affectionately, calling you "Senior."

Of course, she's not actually your junior at the company... but does that really matter?

Game Features

An FMV Cinematic Interactive Game Where YOU Are the Protagonist!

We invite you to a highly vivid and realistic FMV game, created with beautiful actresses and professional drama production know-how.

A Highly Immersive Mystery & Dating Sim Themed Around an Escape Room

  • High-definition video implemented through full-motion video filming with real actors.

  • First-person perspective dialogue and choice-based UI for a vivid immersion, as if you are actually trapped in the office.

  • Maximized tension and romantic atmosphere through BGM and sound effects.

  • Intuitive interface that allows even FMV beginners to play with ease.

Multiple Endings Forged by Choice and Suspicion

  • Choice elements like searching for clues in an 'escape room format' and managing affection levels add thrilling tension to every branching point.

  • Progress by solving problems using clues obtained from clearing mini-games.

  • In addition to the main endings, numerous hidden BAD ENDs and secret endings await.

  • Experience the fun of discovering new branches and conclusions with every replay.

A Unique Worldview & Tension-Filled Story

  • The subtle, captivating charm of attractive female characters juxtaposed against an escape room setting.

  • The protagonist's inner conflict over 'who to escape with.'

  • Unexpected situations and mysteries that maintain a gripping tension throughout your playthrough.

Irresistible Heroines & Diverse Relationship Developments

  • Five distinct characters: a new recruit, a PR team leader, a barista, an ad model, and a building cleaner.

  • Hidden secrets, unique storylines, and different ending routes dedicated to each character.

  • Experience a rollercoaster of emotions, ranging from prickly teasing to heart-fluttering sweet moments.

About INSTER

Hello!

We are a creative group providing digital content solutions in the media sector,

collaborating with skilled experts based on Technology, Creative, and People.

We bring 17 years of expertise in content production and post-production, having successfully completed over 270 domestic and international projects.

Drawing from our deep expertise and technical skills, we aim to implement solid storytelling and stunning visual aesthetics into a Full Motion Video Interactive Game.

In the second half of 2026, we plan to present "Locked in Love," a game motivated by the thrilling concept of escape rooms.

By stepping into the shoes of the player and experiencing the office escape firsthand, you'll be in for a highly enjoyable ride.

The game offers the thrill of developing relationships with various charming female characters, facing the dilemma of 'who to escape with,'

and encountering unexpected twists and turns.

We ask for your great interest and support!

data.short_description: An interactive escape room game where your choices determine your fate. Right before a "long holiday," you find yourself trapped in the office with beautiful women for unknown reasons. Collect clues, cooperate with them, and escape this place!
data.supported_languages:
English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8.1, 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8400 AMD Athlon 64 X2 6000+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia® GTX 460 or AMD HD 5850 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400F AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia® GeForce GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
